SCENE sc_001 0-86000 EXT. HERBAL GARDEN - NIGHT
EP15:E1 0-3500 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot of the raised planter beds illuminated by the pale moonlight as three shadowy figures march purposefully down the central stone path.
EP15:E2 0-3500 ACTION: Three menacing thugs, armed with clubs and tools, stalk through the quiet herbal garden surrounded by stone walls.
EP15:E3 3500-5000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot focusing on one thug raising a heavy wooden club overhead.
EP15:E4 3600-4900 ACTION: The thug brutally smashes his club down into a wooden planter box, shattering the frame.
EP15:E5 3800-4900 SOUND: A splintering wooden crash echoing through the night air.
EP15:E6 5000-7500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.
EP15:E7 5100-7400 ACTION: The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.
EP15:E8 7500-11800 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.
EP15:E9 7600-11800 ACTION: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.
EP15:E10 8500-11700 JULIANA [Desperate, Alarmed]: "Stop! What are you doing?!"
EP15:E11 11800-15800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.
EP15:E12 13000-15700 THUG WITH CAP [Mocking, Smug]: "We're clearing this rubbish."
EP15:E13 15800-18800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.
EP15:E14 16400-18700 JULIANA [Furious, Pleading]: "Those are medicinal plants!"
EP15:E15 18800-22500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.
EP15:E16 20000-22300 BALD THUG [Callous]: "They look like weeds to me."
EP15:E17 20500-22500 ACTION: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
EP15:E18 22500-26800 CAMERA: High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
EP15:E19 22800-26500 ACTION: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.
EP15:E20 23200-26300 JULIANA [Choked with Tears, Desperate]: "Please! Those plants took months to grow!"
EP15:E21 26800-31500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.
EP15:E22 27500-31200 TALL THUG [Contemptuous, Derisive]: "Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?"
EP15:E23 31500-34000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.
EP15:E24 34000-37000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.
EP15:E25 34800-36800 JULIANA [Defiant, Firm]: "Leave my garden alone."
EP15:E26 37000-40500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.
EP15:E27 37200-40400 THUG WITH CAP [Sneering, Disdainful]: "A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke."
EP15:E28 40500-44200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.
EP15:E29 41000-44000 JULIANA [Resolute, Dignified]: "It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here."
EP15:E30 44200-46500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.
EP15:E31 44800-46400 THUG WITH CAP [Menacing Snarl]: "Get out of the way!"
EP15:E32 46500-48000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.
EP15:E33 46500-47300 JULIANA [Steely, Fearless]: "No."
EP15:E34 47400-49500 ACTION: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.
EP15:E35 47800-49000 JULIANA [Gasping Cry]: "Ah!"
EP15:E36 49500-53500 CAMERA: Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
EP15:E37 50000-53500 ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
EP15:E38 53500-56500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.
EP15:E39 53500-55700 JULIANA [Broken, Sobbing]: "My mother's plants..."
EP15:E40 56500-60000 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.
EP15:E41 57300-59800 BALD THUG [Cruel, Laughing]: "Look at her! Crying over weeds!"
EP15:E42 60000-62000 ACTION: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.
EP15:E43 60000-61000 JULIANA [Screaming]: "Stop!"
EP15:E44 62000-63200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.
EP15:E45 63200-67500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.
EP15:E46 63500-67500 ACTION: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
EP15:E47 67500-73500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.
EP15:E48 70500-72600 JULIANA [Whispered Breath, Stunned]: "Alexander..."
EP15:E49 73500-75500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.
EP15:E50 75500-78500 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.
EP15:E51 76000-78500 ACTION: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
EP15:E52 78500-82800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.
EP15:E53 79000-82400 THUG WITH CAP [Challenging, Arrogant]: "What? You want to fight us, veteran?"
EP15:E54 82800-86000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.
EP15:E55 84000-86000 SOUND: Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.
